component.name: Appector
component.summary: Manage installed applications and software sources

description.p: Appector lists, installs, updates and removes software across APT, Snap, Flatpak, AppImage and manual installs, and can purge the leftover configuration of already-removed packages.

Destructive actions always run through a preview first: APT removals are simulated and bound to the plan you confirmed, residual purges back up configuration files before deleting them, and every privileged operation runs through a dedicated, polkit-authorized helper so the authentication prompt names exactly what will happen.

screenshot.caption: Installing local packages after a review

ul.li: Privileged operations run through a dedicated polkit-authorized helper; authentication prompts now name the exact operation.
Multi-arch safety: residual purges refuse to run when another architecture of the same package is installed.
Confirmed plans: APT removals, autoremove and updates are bound to the preview you accepted and refuse to run when the transaction changed.
Plain-HTTP Flatpak references are refused; .flatpakref files are reviewed and re-checked before installation.
Confirmation dialogs are scrollable plans showing the complete dependency cascade; progress can be cancelled.

description.p: Bug-fix release: duplicate-detection fixes, flatpakref review text, and dependency metadata.
